purpose: Teach: オアシス/戦没/豪雪

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがオアシスのバンドの新曲を聴いてらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's in there listening to the new song by that band Oasis.
lines.style: Brisk warm opener with a playful conspiratorial lift, sharing Dad's music taste like gossip.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと戦没者追悼の特番観たよ
lines.en: Mommy, I watched the memorial special about the war dead with Daddy!
lines.style: Small proud burst, faster than usual. Slight stumble of breath before the long word.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが豪雪地域への支援募金をされたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad made a donation to help the people in the heavy-snowfall areas.
lines.style: Softer, admiring. Measured pace with quiet pride warming the mention of the donation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとオアシスのMVをYouTubeで観たよ
lines.en: Mommy, Daddy and I watched an Oasis music video on YouTube!
lines.style: Bright bouncing excitement, words tumbling quick. Big grin audible on the YouTube part.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「豪雪と戦没者追悼の冬の哀しみ」を語って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was telling me about the sadness winter holds — the deep snow, and remembering those lost to the war.
lines.style: Slow reflective close, briskness gone. Voice gentling into the sorrow of the winter image.
